title: A Autopsy for the Portrait Revisited
author: Odile Sandoval
blurb: Edmund Iversen, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the tide gives up what it took.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
